notes: Phase 1 strongly connected components via src/algorithms/connectivity/strong.rs. Iterative two-pass Kosaraju mirroring igraph_i_connected_components_strong. Karate-undirected (2.44 µs) is the SCC->WCC delegate path; karate-directed (4.49 µs) is the actual two-pass DFS. Linear scan on directed cycles: 96 ns/vertex at n=100, 85 ns/vertex at n=1000, 86 ns/vertex at n=10000 — confirms O(V+E) asymptotic with constant per-vertex cost. Like CC-001 the dominant overhead is per-vertex Vec alloc in out_neighbors_vec/in_neighbors_vec, addressable via slice-returning APIs in a future CORE-001 perf pass.
